description: This file defines a custom matcher 'toHaveURL' for Playwright testing, including the main function 'toHaveURLWithPredicate' and a helper 'toHaveURLMessage' for formatting messages.

methods.name: toHaveURLWithPredicate
methods.description: Asynchronous function that waits for a URL condition on a Playwright page, returning a MatcherResult indicating success or failure.

methods.name: toHaveURLMessage
methods.description: Helper function that formats the message shown when the URL expectation fails or succeeds.
